content.comment_body: Hello everyone, The [product_name] (article number: [article_no]) has been powered off for three months. Could someone inform me how long the application program backup will remain stored in the device while it is without power? Thank you.

When you transfer a user program with [product_name] software, it gets stored in non-volatile flash memory and remains there indefinitely. However, if the device is without power for three months, the Real Time Clock (RTC) will need to be manually set again, as it only maintains time accuracy for about 20 days without power.
Thanks for the helpful information. Regards

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to know how long the application program stays saved in the device after long periods without power. Replies confirm that the user program is kept in non-volatile flash memory and retained indefinitely, but note that the clock function will need to be reset after roughly 20 days without power.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the device to safely store the application program for extended periods without power and want confirmation of its data retention reliability.
pain_keywords: RTC reset required after extended power-off
